rows.line: 正解は素直にありがとうとごめんなさいが言える子かな。
rows.en1: Someone who can just say thanks and sorry.
rows.en2: Just owning it and saying sorry.

rows.line: 「かな」というところまでの余白が大事ですね。
rows.en1: It's all about that little pause.
rows.en2: The space in between is what matters.

rows.line: 現実世界の違うとこに引っ張られすぎたら
rows.en1: You're getting way too hung up on that.
rows.en2: Don't get dragged into that too much.

rows.ja: それを言っちゃおしまいだよ
rows.line: それも言っちゃおしまいだよ。
rows.en1: Come on, you can't say that.
rows.en2: Well, that kills the whole thing.

rows.ja: 真っ正面からぶつかる
rows.line: やっぱり真っ正面からぶつかって。
rows.en1: Just go at it head-on.
rows.en2: Take it straight on.

rows.line: まあまあ、本当は迷いどころですね。
rows.en1: That's a tough call.
rows.en2: Honestly, I could go either way.

rows.line: まあでも当然の結果っちゃ当然の結果なんで。
rows.en1: I mean, it was bound to happen.
rows.en2: Kind of saw that coming, honestly.

rows.line: じゃあね、実績を残したからねぇ。
rows.en1: Hey, he got it done.
rows.en2: Well, he's got the results to show for it.

rows.ja: いいとこ出してきたな
rows.line: なかなかいいとこ出してきたなぁと思ってるんだろ。
rows.en1: You think you nailed that one, huh?
rows.en2: Bet you think that was a good pull.

rows.line: ごめんなさい、気合が前に出すぎて。
rows.en1: Sorry, I got a little too fired up.
rows.en2: My bad, got a little carried away.

rows.line: 本当はもっと盛り上がると思っちゃうんですよね。
rows.en1: You'd think it'd be way more fun.
rows.en2: I figured it'd be crazier than this.

rows.line: それを踏まえてどうですか？
rows.en1: So with that in mind, what do you think?
rows.en2: Knowing that, how do you feel?

rows.line: すっごい真面目に答えちゃってたんです。マジかー。
rows.en1: No way.
rows.en2: Are you serious?

rows.line: わかるわけないよ。
rows.en1: How would I know?
rows.en2: There's no way anyone knows that.

rows.line: 竹内先輩に一生ついていくと決めた次第であります。
rows.en1: I'll follow you anywhere, man.
rows.en2: I'm with you for life.

rows.line: 正義感あふれる言葉に感銘を受け
rows.en1: That really hit me.
rows.en2: That stuck with me big time.

rows.ja: 何を言ってるんですか
rows.line: 何を言ってるんですか。親が子供に見せてもいい番組
rows.en1: What are you talking about?
rows.en2: Come on, what are you saying?

rows.line: 楽しみにしてましたからね。
rows.en1: I've been looking forward to this.
rows.en2: I've been waiting for this one.

rows.ja: よーくお考えください
rows.line: よーくお考え下さい。
rows.en1: Think real hard.
rows.en2: Take your time with this one.

rows.ja: いい加減にしてください
rows.line: いい加減にしてください、本当に。
rows.en1: Oh, give me a break.
rows.en2: Come on, knock it off.

rows.line: これ勘弁してください、本当に。
rows.en1: Please, spare me.
rows.en2: Oh man, have mercy.

rows.line: 今生きてるの誰のおかげ？
rows.en1: Who do you think got you here?
rows.en2: Who do you owe all this to?

rows.line: もう目つぶっててもなんか余裕で答えてほしかった
rows.en1: You should be able to do that in your sleep.
rows.en2: That should've been a no-brainer.

rows.line: 残念、最悪だよもう。
rows.en1: Ugh, this is the worst.
rows.en2: Man, that sucks.

rows.line: すげーとこ来たみたいな顔したんですよ。
rows.en1: He looked at me like I'd just nailed it.
rows.en2: He gave me this 'oh, you got it' look.

rows.line: あんぺーにバカにされたんですよ。
rows.en1: He was making fun of me.
rows.en2: He totally played me.

rows.line: 考えるだけもう無駄。
rows.en1: No point even thinking about it.
rows.en2: It's a waste of time even trying.

rows.line: なんだろ、抽象的すぎる感じがするんですよね。
rows.en1: I don't know, it just feels too vague.
rows.en2: It kind of feels too abstract, you know?

rows.ja: はっきり言ってしまうと
rows.line: ハッキリ言ってしまうと、量がちゃいますから。
rows.en1: To be blunt,
rows.en2: Let's be honest,

rows.line: まあ想像通りって感じですかね。
rows.en1: Pretty much what I expected.
rows.en2: About how I pictured it.

rows.line: いじられたのがその気に食わないですよ。
rows.en1: I didn't love getting roasted like that.
rows.en2: Getting picked on like that bugs me.

rows.ja: もうどうしたらいいですか
rows.line: 俺の物件探しはもうどうしたらいいですか？
rows.en1: What am I supposed to do now?
rows.en2: So now what?

rows.line: 負けてしまったことに涙が止まりません。
rows.en1: I can't stop crying.
rows.en2: I'm literally in tears.

rows.line: ママが甘やかしまくった結果、それが野村周平。
rows.en1: That's what happens when mom spoils you rotten.
rows.en2: That's what you get from being babied.

rows.line: 白熱した勝負でしたねー。
rows.en1: That was a close one.
rows.en2: That got heated.
